author: The Current
description:
Tommy Brennan of 'Saturday Night Live' looks back on his Weekend Update segment about ICE in Minnesota
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

St. Paul's Tommy Brennan of "Saturday Night Live" looks back on his January 17, 2026, cut-for-time Weekend Update feature where he discussed Minnesota’s response to ICE deployments. "All I had to say was like, 'Minnesotans rock, and I’m really proud to be from there,'" Brennan says. 

Brennan's full segment from Weekend Update can be viewed on the SNL YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uA8Oury0a80

author: The Current
description:
Watch Flock of Dimes perform "Hard Way"  in a small music venue in Minneapolis
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Flock of Dimes — the solo project of multi-instrumentalist and producer Jenn Wasner — released her third album, "The Life You Save," on October 10, 2025, on Sub Pop Records.

Wasner visited Minneapolis to perform a MicroShow — a series from The Current that presents live music in intimate or unexpected music venues — to perform songs from the new album as well as a few selections from her back catalogue. The audience in attendance comprised lucky winners who entered for a chance to attend this show.

Thank you to Gertens Garden Center for its support of this MicroShow.

Musicians
Jenn Wasner – vocals and guitar
Alan Good Parker – guitar
